tools.name: get_launch_info
tools.description: Release date of GTA VI, days remaining, and how much community data the Vice City Mission map and tracker have so far. Call this first if unsure whether data exists yet.

tools.name: get_game_info
tools.description: Confirmed facts about GTA VI: quick facts (price, platforms, editions), the playable and supporting characters, and the regions of Leonida with their real-world inspirations. Each item is marked official, reported or community estimate.

tools.name: get_music
tools.description: Confirmed GTA VI music: radio stations (genre, on-air hosts, reported voice actors, previewed songs), Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album singles, Justice's original score, and songs from each trailer. Each song includes streaming search links (Spotify, Apple Music, Tidal, YouTube Music). Full tracklists

tools.name: get_news
tools.description: Major GTA VI announcements, newest first, each with a date, status (official/reported/community) and source links.

tools.name: search_landmarks
tools.description: Search ~1,900 GTA VI locations matched to the real Miami/Florida places they're based on (community data from map.gtadb.org, CC BY 4.0). Search by in-game area or by real place, e.g. 'Ocean Drive', 'Bal Harbour', 'Vice Beach', 'airport'. Optionally limit to a radius around an in-game position (meter

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: The kinds of locations on the map (missions, collectibles, weapons, vehicles, shops, activities, secrets) with how many pins each has.

tools.name: search_locations
tools.description: Search community-submitted GTA VI map pins by text and/or category. Returns name, category, details, position in in-game meters (x east, y north), vote count, verified flag and a link to the pin on the map.

tools.name: get_location
tools.description: Full details for one map pin by its id.

tools.name: find_nearby
tools.description: Find pins close to another pin or to a map position, nearest first. Positions are in-game meters (x east, y north, matching map.gtadb.org); distances are in meters.

tools.name: get_checklist
tools.description: The completion checklist from the Vice City Mission tracker: story missions, side missions, activities, collectibles and trophies. Item ids match the tracker's saved progress.

tools.name: checklist_remaining
tools.description: Given the ids a player has completed (from the tracker's 'Copy progress for AI' button), return what is still left, with missable items first, and the completion percentage.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "list_categories" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: The kinds of locations on the map (missions, collectibles, weapons, vehicles, shops, activities, secrets) with how many pins each has.
